slides.text:
Today we will: Use today’s English with Pip.
Hello, hello, red! 
 Hello, hello, blue! 
 red, red — say it loud! 
 blue, blue — say it loud! 
 green, green — say it loud! 
 Clap, stomp, jump — let's go!
Warm-up SONG POSTER for a kawaii kids storybook. LAYOUT (strict): • A large soft-white rounded lyric card fills the CENTER of the frame (about 60% of the image area), with a thick clean black outline and gentle drop shadow. • A bright yellow/orange decorative TITLE RIBBON is pinned across the TOP of the card, reading "Sing with us!" as bold hand-lettered kawaii display type. • The song lyrics are rendered INSIDE the white card, centered, in a clean bold kid-friendly hand-lettered font, one line per lyric line, plenty of breathing room, perfectly spelled. • Bella the bunny stands in the BOTTOM-LEFT corner in a joyful mid-action singing pose — happy face, one paw raised, small motion sparkles. Do NOT place the character on top of the lyric card and do NOT let any lyric text cover the character. • Beautiful detailed background BEHIND the card: cozy classroom with a colorful rug, bookshelf and big window. Soft depth, warm cinematic lighting. HARD RULES: NO speech bubbles, NO thought bubbles, NO dialogue balloons, NO caption boxes anywhere. The lyric card is a POSTER, not dialogue. Do NOT render the words of this prompt anywhere — only the lyrics provided by the TEXT OVERLAY RULE. CHARACTER LOOK BOOK (render EXACTLY as described, identical across every scene — same fur color, same eyes, same outfit, same proportions):
- Bella the bunny — soft pastel-pink rabbit, long floppy ears with pale blush inner lining, cream muzzle, big sparkly violet eyes, tiny pink nose, wearing a buttery-yellow pinafore dress with a white collar and pink ballet flats.

Warm-up song poster
blocks.prompt:
Warm-up SONG POSTER for a kawaii kids storybook. LAYOUT (strict): • A large soft-white rounded lyric card fills the CENTER of the frame (about 60% of the image area), with a thick clean black outline and gentle drop shadow. • A bright yellow/orange decorative TITLE RIBBON is pinned across the TOP of the card, reading "Sing with us!" as bold hand-lettered kawaii display type. • The song lyrics are rendered INSIDE the white card, centered, in a clean bold kid-friendly hand-lettered font, one line per lyric line, plenty of breathing room, perfectly spelled. • Pip the fox stands in the BOTTOM-LEFT corner in a joyful mid-action singing pose — happy face, one paw raised, small motion sparkles. Do NOT place the character on top of the lyric card and do NOT let any lyric text cover the character. • Beautiful detailed background BEHIND the card: friendly town park with a pond, picnic table and flowers. Soft depth, warm cinematic lighting. HARD RULES: NO speech bubbles, NO thought bubbles, NO dialogue balloons, NO caption boxes anywhere. The lyric card is a POSTER, not dialogue. Do NOT render the words of this prompt anywhere — only the lyrics provided by the TEXT OVERLAY RULE. - Pip the fox — small, cheerful red fox cub, bright orange fur with a cream white belly and cheeks, fluffy white-tipped tail, big round amber eyes, tiny black nose, wearing a soft sky-blue hooded sweater and white sneakers.

Do NOT render the words of this prompt anywhere — only the lyrics provided by the TEXT OVERLAY RULE. - Pip the fox — small, cheerful red fox cub, bright orange fur with a cream white belly and cheeks, fluffy white-tipped tail, big round amber eyes, tiny black nose, wearing a soft sky-blue hooded sweater and white sneakers.

Today we will: Use today’s English with Pip.

 small, small — say it loud!

 Clap, stomp, jump — let's go!
Warm-up SONG POSTER for a kawaii kids storybook. LAYOUT (strict): • A large soft-white rounded lyric card fills the CENTER of the frame (about 60% of the image area), with a thick clean black outline and gentle drop shadow. • A bright yellow/orange decorative TITLE RIBBON is pinned across the TOP of the card, reading "Sing with us!" as bold hand-lettered kawaii display type. • The song lyrics are rendered INSIDE the white card, centered, in a clean bold kid-friendly hand-lettered font, one line per lyric line, plenty of breathing room, perfectly spelled. • Pip the fox stands in the BOTTOM-LEFT corner in a joyful mid-action singing pose — happy face, one paw raised, small motion sparkles. Do NOT place the character on top of the lyric card and do NOT let any lyric text cover the character. • Beautiful detailed background BEHIND the card: friendly town park with a pond, picnic table and flowers. Soft depth, warm cinematic lighting. HARD RULES: NO speech bubbles, NO thought bubbles, NO dialogue balloons, NO caption boxes anywhere. The lyric card is a POSTER, not dialogue. Do NOT render the words of this prompt anywhere — only the lyrics provided by the TEXT OVERLAY RULE. CHARACTER LOOK BOOK (render EXACTLY as described, identical across every scene — same fur color, same eyes, same outfit, same proportions):
- Pip the fox — small, cheerful red fox cub, bright orange fur with a cream white belly and cheeks, fluffy white-tipped tail, big round amber eyes, tiny black nose, wearing a soft sky-blue hooded sweater and white sneakers.

Warm-up song poster
blocks.prompt:
Warm-up SONG POSTER for a kawaii kids storybook. LAYOUT (strict): • A large soft-white rounded lyric card fills the CENTER of the frame (about 60% of the image area), with a thick clean black outline and gentle drop shadow. • A bright yellow/orange decorative TITLE RIBBON is pinned across the TOP of the card, reading "Sing with us!" as bold hand-lettered kawaii display type. • The song lyrics are rendered INSIDE the white card, centered, in a clean bold kid-friendly hand-lettered font, one line per lyric line, plenty of breathing room, perfectly spelled. • Pip the fox stands in the BOTTOM-LEFT corner in a joyful mid-action singing pose — happy face, one paw raised, small motion sparkles. Do NOT place the character on top of the lyric card and do NOT let any lyric text cover the character. • Beautiful detailed background BEHIND the card: friendly town park with a pond, picnic table and flowers. Soft depth, warm cinematic lighting. HARD RULES: NO speech bubbles, NO thought bubbles, NO dialogue balloons, NO caption boxes anywhere. The lyric card is a POSTER, not dialogue. Do NOT render the words of this prompt anywhere — only the lyrics provided by the TEXT OVERLAY RULE. CHARACTER LOOK BOOK (render EXACTLY as described, identical across every scene — same fur color, same eyes, same outfit, same proportions):
- Pip the fox — small, cheerful red fox cub, bright orange fur with a cream white belly and cheeks, fluffy white-tipped tail, big round amber eyes, tiny black nose, wearing a soft sky-blue hooded sweater and white sneakers.

Do NOT place the character on top of the lyric card and do NOT let any lyric text cover the character. • Beautiful detailed background BEHIND the card: village market street with little shops and balloons. Do NOT render the words of this prompt anywhere — only the lyrics provided by the TEXT OVERLAY RULE. LAYOUT (strict): • A large soft-white rounded lyric card fills the CENTER of the frame (about 60% of the image area), with a thick clean black outline and gentle drop shadow. • A bright yellow/orange decorative TITLE RIBBON is pinned across the TOP of the card, reading "Sing with us!" as bold hand-lettered kawaii display type. • The song lyrics are rendered INSIDE the white card, centered, in a clean bold kid-friendly hand-lettered font, one line per lyric line, plenty of breathing room, perfectly spelled. • Pip the fox stands in the BOTTOM-LEFT corner in a joyful mid-action singing pose — happy face, one paw raised, small motion sparkles. Do NOT place the character on top of the lyric card and do NOT let any lyric text cover the character. • Beautiful detailed background BEHIND the card: forest clearing with mushrooms, friendly birds and soft sunlight. Soft depth, warm cinematic lighting. HARD RULES: NO speech bubbles, NO thought bubbles, NO dialogue balloons, NO caption boxes anywhere. The lyric card is a POSTER, not dialogue. Do NOT render the words of this prompt anywhere — only the lyrics provided by the TEXT OVERLAY RULE. - Pip the fox — small, cheerful red fox cub, bright orange fur with a cream white belly and cheeks, fluffy white-tipped tail, big round amber eyes, tiny black nose, wearing a soft sky-blue hooded sweater and white sneakers.
